title: 第21章 黑心和尚第22章 澜沧五美
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
第二是峨眉金顶派俗家弟子中百年难遇的天才；
第一则是个来历不明的散修，据说曾经正面硬撼过抱丹期的老怪物而不落下风。
但江湖上的人都知道，人榜前三和后面的排名，根本不是一个量级的。
可即便如此，真玄的蹿升速度也足以让人瞠目结舌。
更让刘伯温印象深刻的是，自家那几个在真如寺修行的子侄，每次回家探亲，说起真玄师叔，都是满脸的崇拜和敬畏。
“如松那孩子说，”刘伯温心中暗道，“真玄师叔的《阿难破戒刀》已经到了登堂入室的境界，一刀下去，便是抱丹期的高手也未必接得住。”
想到这里，他不由得又看了真玄一眼，心中有些敬畏。
这位真玄大师，是真的厉害，但也真的可怕。
江湖上给他起了个外号，叫“黑心和尚”。
这个外号的来由，说起来也简单，与真玄动手过手的江湖人，不是当场毙命就是后续失踪。
当然，切磋的那种不算。
不管是和真如寺有仇怨的对头还在江湖上行走时遇到的各路强人，但凡跟真玄交过手的，反正没有一个听说有续集的。
有人说这是真如寺《阿难破戒刀》的杀性太重，也有人说真玄本就是心狠手辣之辈。
刘伯温不知道哪个说法是真的，反正他觉得眼前这位看似温文尔雅的年轻僧人笑起来有点渗人就是了。
他的恭敬，不仅仅是出于对真如寺的供奉，更是出于对强者本能的敬畏。
“大师，”刘伯温收敛了心神，侧身做了个“请”的手势，“此处不是说话的地方，请大师移步刘府，容晚辈详细禀报。”
真玄点了点头，跟着刘伯温走出了茶楼。
门外停着两辆马车，车夫显然早就得了信，见人出来，连忙掀开车帘。
刘伯温亲自扶着车辕，等真玄上了车，自己才坐到前面那辆车上，吩咐车夫：“回府，快些。”

马车穿过几条街巷，约莫一炷香的功夫，在一座气派的府邸门前停了下来。
真玄掀开车帘，便见一座三间五架的朱漆大门，门楣上悬着一块匾额，上书“刘府”二字，金光闪闪。
门前蹲着两尊石狮子，雕工精湛，栩栩如生。
七八个家丁正在门前洒扫，见马车停下，连忙迎了上来。
刘伯温快步走到真玄面前，道：“大师，请。”
真玄下了车，目光在府邸门前扫了一眼，便跟着刘伯温走了进去。
刘府占地极广，进了大门，是一条青石铺就的甬道，两旁种着两排银杏树，时值初冬，金黄的叶子落了满地，踩上去沙沙作响。
甬道尽头是一座高大的影壁，绕过影壁，眼前豁然开朗，便是一个方圆数丈的天井，正中摆着一口大铜缸，缸中养着几尾锦鲤，悠闲地游来游去。
穿过天井，便是正堂。
正堂面阔五间，进深三间，雕梁画栋，气派非凡。
堂中摆着紫檀木的桌椅，墙上挂着名人字画，案上供着时令鲜花，处处透着富贵气息。
但此刻，正堂中已经坐满了人。
真玄踏进正堂的瞬间，所有人的目光都齐刷刷地看了过来。

;;
The second is a rare genius among lay disciples of the Emei Jinding Sect;
The first is a casual cultivator of unknown origin. It is said that he once defeated an old monster in the Dan Bao stage head-on without losing.
But everyone in the world knows that the top three and the following rankings are not at the same level.
But even so, Zhenxuan's rising speed is enough to make people jaw-dropping.
What impressed Liu Bowen even more was that every time his nephews and nephews who practiced in Zhenru Temple came home to visit relatives, they were full of admiration and awe when they talked about Uncle Zhenxuan.
"That kid Rusong said," Liu Bowen thought to himself, "Uncle Zhenxuan's "Ananda's Sword of Breaking the Precepts" has reached the level of breaking into a house. Even a master in the alchemy stage may not be able to catch it with one strike."
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but look at Zhenxuan again, feeling a little in awe.
This Master Zhenxuan is really powerful, but also really scary.
He was nicknamed "Black-hearted Monk" by the people in the world.
The origin of this nickname is simple to say. The Jianghu people who had a hand with Zhenxuan were either killed on the spot or disappeared later.
Of course, the kind of sparring does not count.
Regardless of whether it was the enemies who had a grudge against Zhenru Temple and the strong men from all walks of life they met while walking around the world, no one who had fought against Zhenxuan had ever heard of a sequel.
Some people say that this is because Zhenru Temple's "Ananda Pojie Sword" is too murderous, while others say that Zhenxuan is a ruthless person.
Liu Bowen didn't know which statement was true. Anyway, he felt that the seemingly gentle young monk in front of him had a smile that was a bit charming.
His respect was not only out of worship to Zhenru Temple, but also out of his instinctive awe for the strong.
"Master," Liu Bowen calmed down and made a "please" gesture sideways, "This is not the place to talk. Master, please move to the Liu Mansion and allow me to give you a detailed report."
Zhenxuan nodded and followed Liu Bowen out of the teahouse.
There were two carriages parked outside the door. The coachmen had obviously gotten the message a long time ago. When they saw someone coming out, they quickly opened the curtains.
Liu Bowen personally held the shaft of the car and waited for Zhenxuan to get on the car. Then he sat in the car in front and told the driver: "Go back home and hurry up."
The carriage passed through several streets and alleys, and in about the time it took to burn an incense stick, it stopped in front of a magnificent mansion.
Zhenxuan opened the curtain and saw a red lacquer door with three rooms and five frames. On the lintel hung a plaque with the word "Liu Mansion" written in it, shining with golden light.
There are two stone lions squatting in front of the door. The carvings are exquisite and lifelike.
Seven or eight servants were sweeping in front of the door. When they saw the carriage stop, they hurriedly came to greet it.
Liu Bowen quickly walked up to Zhenxuan and said, "Master, please."
Zhenxuan got out of the car, glanced at the door of the mansion, and followed Liu Bowen in.
The Liu Mansion occupies a very large area. After entering the gate, there is a corridor paved with bluestone, with two rows of ginkgo trees planted on both sides. It is early winter, and the golden leaves have fallen all over the ground, making a rustling sound when you step on them.
At the end of the corridor is a tall screen wall. When you go around the screen wall, you suddenly see a patio with a radius of several feet. In the middle is a large copper tank with several koi carps swimming around leisurely.
Passing through the patio is the main hall.
The main hall is five rooms wide and three rooms deep, with carved beams and painted pillars, giving it an extraordinary style.
There are rosewood tables and chairs in the hall, celebrity calligraphy and paintings are hung on the walls, and seasonal flowers are placed on the tables. There is an atmosphere of wealth everywhere.
But at this moment, the main hall was already full of people.
The moment Zhenxuan stepped into the main hall, everyone's eyes turned towards him.
